questions.context: Grade Pre-2 6 A Friend in Spain Sophie was born in America and now works in her hometown. She spent a year studying abroad in Spain when she was a college student. One of the friends she met during that time was Andre. They quickly became good friends. They talked about many things, like their dreams. One day, she asked (21). He said that he wanted to be an actor. He told her that he had been working very hard on his training. Five years later, Sophie was watching a Spanish movie on TV. She felt that one of the characters looked very familiar. She looked closely at his face and saw that it was Andre. Later, she learned from the Internet that he had been an actor for a few years. She felt that (22). This made her so happy. And she learned from this experience that she should also take action to make her own dream come true.
